name: Dodanim
title: Son of Javan
summary: Dodanim was a son of Javan and a grandson of Japheth, who in turn was a son of Noah. He is mentioned in Genesis and 1 Chronicles as part of the genealogy after the flood. Dodanim is traditionally regarded as the ancestor of the peoples who settled on the islands and coastal areas of the Mediterranean, possibly linked to Rhodes or the Dardanians.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in the genealogy after the flood
keyEvents.description: Dodanim is listed as one of Javan's four sons in the genealogy in Genesis chapter 10, which describes how the nations spread out after the flood.

keyEvents.title: Descendants of Javan and the coastal peoples
keyEvents.description: In connection with Javan's sons, it is mentioned that the land of the coastlands was distributed among these descendants, each according to their language and clan.

keyEvents.title: Japheth's Lineage
keyEvents.description: Dodanim belongs to Japheth's lineage, one of Noah's three sons. Japheth's descendants are associated with the peoples north and west of Israel.

keyEvents.title: Repeated in the Genealogies of Chronicles
keyEvents.description: Dodanim (here called Rodanim in some manuscripts) is mentioned again in 1 Chronicles as part of the extensive genealogy that opens the book.

keyEvents.title: Part of Noah's Descendants
keyEvents.description: Dodanim is part of the larger narrative about Noah's descendants who filled the earth after the flood, in accordance with God's command to be fruitful and fill the earth.
